note: The Claude Code surfaces Clawdling relies on, and the versions checked against them (SPEC-1.8 3.3). `clawdling doctor --contract` checks the installed CLI against this file; the nightly workflow checks each new release and bumps maxChecked. min: Windows hooks use exec form (2.1.139); StopFailure has its own gate (2.1.229, hooks.js).
hookCheck: claude doctor in a temporary folder whose .claude/settings.json declares every event plus a made-up one: doctor names an unknown event ("Unknown hook event"), so the made-up one proves the check ran and ours must not appear. Verified on 2.1.308.
